limitations: Provider success means transport/JSON-object success, not question correctness or agent gate success.
Canary author calls are injected local objects; their solve/review calls are live. agent.call_count includes injected authors.
Frozen fixture contexts bypass live retrieval and do not evaluate RAG.
Three live-author cases per run, one output slot each; internal gates are not an independent final grader.
A2 was adapted after A1 results on the same development cases; no held-out generalization claim.
All observed provider cost fields are missing. known_cost_usd=0 in original summaries is an empty known-cost sum, not a billed total.
Hashes computed in this audit provide a current archive fingerprint, not a pre-experiment immutable attestation.
Snapshots include nine selected source files, not the whole import closure, dataset, dependency lock or sanitized full provider request parameters.
